_comment: D:/tools/kicad-mcp-server and run under KiCad's own Python so pcbnew is
importable - that is what gives real track lengths, via counts and
signal-integrity figures instead of text-parsed guesses.
It exposes 47 tools. Roughly 40 read, analyse, validate or export; seven
WHICH TOOLS ARE ALLOWED HERE DEPENDS ON THE MODE - see AGENTS.md rules 8
and 9 and docs/decisions/0012. The short version: the analysis tools are
always safe; the seven write tools edit files directly and therefore count
as hand edits, which generate_board.py and populate_schematic.py erase.
Do not install a second KiCad MCP alongside this one. The IPC-API servers
were evaluated and rejected for KiCad 10: the IPC API cannot export or
plot before KiCad 11, so it can edit a board but cannot run the checks
that prove the edit was safe.
